native_rule.creator: bhanu.nandanampati@nopalcyber.com
native_rule.name: [NopalCyber]Steganographic Payload Execution via Image File
native_rule.s1ql: event.type = "Process Creation" AND device.os_type = "windows" AND src.process.name CONTAINS_ANYCASE "powershell" AND (src.process.cmdline CONTAINS_ANYCASE ".png" OR src.process.cmdline CONTAINS_ANYCASE ".bmp" OR src.process.cmdline CONTAINS_ANYCASE ".jpg" OR src.process.cmdline CONTAINS_ANYCASE ".jpeg") AND (src.process.cmdline CONTAINS_ANYCASE "System.Reflection.Assembly::Load" OR src.process.cmdline CONTAINS_ANYCASE "[Convert]::FromBase64String" OR src.process.cmdline CONTAINS_ANYCASE "Add-Type" OR src.process.cmdline CONTAINS_ANYCASE "IEX" OR src.process.cmdline CONTAINS_ANYCASE "Invoke-Expression" ) AND src.process.cmdline !CONTAINS_ANYCASE "installutil" AND src.process.cmdline !CONTAINS_ANYCASE "netstandard"
